documents.title: Public Atlas inventory
documents.text: The Atlas lists public Hugging Face models, kernels, datasets, and Spaces. A listing does not establish readiness or model quality.

documents.title: Source-bound Launchpad
documents.text: The Launchpad registers navigation links from server.SURFACES. Registration does not certify availability, capability, or authorization.

documents.title: Governed product runtime
documents.text: A11oy is the governed product runtime at a-11-oy.com. Command Lab offers a visitor path into the product without granting action authority.

documents.title: Independent proof registry
documents.text: a11oy.net is the independent static proof registry. Inspect proof artifacts separately from the product runtime and catalog links.

documents.title: Advisory anatomy demonstration
documents.text: The five-organ cycle uses synthetic inputs. Healthy checks remain advisory, energy may be unavailable, and Lambda uniqueness is Conjecture 1.
